notes: Elemental at 60: Lightning Bolt spammed the rest of the time, Chain Lightning taking over on 2+ targets, with Searing Totem or Magma Totem dropped depending on target count, and Earth Shock as a mana-percent-gated filler -- matching the community guide's 'totems up, Flame Shock up, then Lightning Bolt' summary; Earth Shock as a mana dump is our own design choice, matching the enhancement rotation's own precedent, not something the guide says. The fork's elemental_shaman/apls/default.apl.json is the starting point but two lines are not adapted as-is: it casts Chain Lightning (10605) with no target-count condition ahead of Lightning Bolt in the priority list, which would fire Chain Lightning on every single-target cast too since it has no ability cooldown of its own -- gated it on numberTargets >= 2 here instead. It also filled its Lightning Bolt line with rank 4 (915) rather than the top rank; used rank 10 (15208), the highest this build's spellconst has, since nothing here calls for downranking. Fix round 1: the first pass here left Earth Shock out over an assumed shared cooldown with Chain Lightning; that assumption was wrong. Read sim/shaman/shocks.go and sim/shaman/chain_lightning.go directly: registerShocks() shares one shockTimer across Earth Shock, Flame Shock, and Frost Shock only, while registerChainLightningSpell() owns an independent cdTimer never tied to that shared timer -- the category_cooldown_ms: 6000 spellconst reports for both the shocks and Chain Lightning is coincidental, not a shared category. A priority list already skips an on-cooldown action and falls through, so Earth Shock is added back as a mana-percent-gated filler ahead of the Lightning Bolt default, the same placement the preset used it in and the same design our own enhancement rotation already uses -- not something the cited guide itself recommends. All non-cast aura references here are dotIsActive checks against Searing Totem (10438), Magma Totem (10587), and Flame Shock (29228); each is registered with its Dot directly on the same spell object as its own ActionID (sim/shaman/fire_totems.go, sim/shaman/flame_shock.go), not via a separate buff-aura helper, so dotIsActive resolves correctly for all three -- verified the same way the enhancement fix below required for Windfury Totem, which does not have this direct self-reference. Rotation-accuracy program, night-lava-burst lane (2026-09-28): added Lava Burst (1238300, top rank; family 408490/1238299/1238300, spell_level 40/50/60) above Chain Lightning, gated on Flame Shock's own dotIsActive (29228) rather than cast unconditionally, since the talent's tooltip bonus (+20% damage) only applies while Flame Shock is on the target and Flame Shock is otherwise kept up continuously by the line above -- the guide's level-60 build (FS1 elemental tree digits) already spends the talent point, and the ladder's own budget=level-9 truncation (sim/leveling/talents.go) does not reach it until budget=31, i.e. level 40, which is also spellranks.json's own learn level for rank 1, so the line resolves to a no-op below level 40 for two independent reasons rather than needing an expected_idle entry. Golden DPS at 40/50/60 actually DROPPED slightly (40.7->40.6, 55.2->54.7, 86.0->84.8; -0.2% to -1.4%): expected, not a defect. This client's Lava Burst is a flat +20%-vs-Flame-Shocked multiplier, not Classic's guaranteed crit, and its sp_coefficient (0.714) over its cast time (2.5s) is 0.343/s even with Call of Flame's +15% (already maxed in this build) applied, versus Lightning Bolt's 0.857 coefficient over 3s = 0.286/s -- Lava Burst's spellpower scaling per cast-second is higher, but its BASE damage per cast-second (220*1.2*1.15/2.5=121/s) is well below Lightning Bolt's (452 avg/3=151/s), so at this ladder's deliberately bare spell power (~0, no gear/buffs/consumables) trading an occasional Lightning Bolt cast for Lava Burst is a net loss. The two scale-with-SP terms cross at roughly 270 spell power (150.83-121.4 = (0.343-0.286)*SP), well within a raid-geared Elemental shaman's range, so this is a bare-ladder artifact, not a reason to drop the line -- FOREVER_LADDER_STRICT=1 reports no new violations from adding it (dps_regression is level-over-level, not before/after a rotation change, and 40/50/60 still each exceed the level below). Fire Nova / Mana Spring lane (2026-10-07): Forever Fire Nova (408341-408345, a ranked instant spell on a 10 s cooldown that needs a live fire totem; engine ids in sim/shaman/fire_nova.go) was swept as an insertion after the totems at no gate and at 20/40/60/80% mana gates: every variant lost DPS (about 3x worse damage per mana than Lightning Bolt in a mana-limited fight), so no Fire Nova line. Mana Spring Totem (10497) was made real in the engine (a five-minute MP5 aura, 10 mana per 2 s at rank 4) and added as a first priority line refreshed at 1.5 s remaining; it beat the previous rotation beyond error (see design/reviews/2026-10-07-shaman-fire-nova.md for paired numbers). Mana Spring sits ahead of autocastOtherCooldowns: the rotation search's swap of the two lines gained 1.9 +/- 0.3 DPS at 3000 iterations on two seeds, so the cooldowns start one global later. The mechanism is not understood; it is the one place in this file where autocastOtherCooldowns is not the first line. Caster tier lane (2026-10-31): the raid band is not mana-limited -- spec-breakdown's out-of-mana line reads well under 1 s of 180 s under the raid preset -- so the earlier 'runs dry either way' sweep, measured on the bare ladder character, no longer decides the raid rotation. Flame Shock is kept up again (one line after the cooldowns, no mana gate: 10% and 20% gates both measured lower) and Lava Burst waits for it, so every Lava Burst carries the +20%; together about +9% at the level-60 raid band. Lava Burst names rank 4 (1326047, level 60, a trainer rank in spellranks.json that the engine fork did not register until this lane). Mana Spring Totem's five minutes and 10 mana every 2 s are the client's own numbers (SpellMisc duration index 5 = 300000 ms; SpellEffect 10494 base 10, period 2000), not a modelling shortcut. Earth Shock is no longer a line: it shares the shock cooldown with Flame Shock and sat below an unconditional Lightning Bolt, so it could only fire when Lightning Bolt was unaffordable, and Earth Shock costs more (the wow-player review called it dead code; the ladder never cast it above level 10 either). Elemental Mastery is not a line because the guide's raid build does not take it and the engine fork leaves it unregistered (sim/shaman/talents.go); an open follow-up, not a rotation choice. Caster tier lane 2 (2026-10-31): Elemental Mastery is registered in the engine (Forever's version: 0.5 sec off Lightning Bolt and Lava Burst for 15 seconds, no Chain Lightning cooldown, 3 minute cooldown) and fires from the cooldowns line; the guide build takes it. Sim audit round 2 (2026-11-01): Fire Nova (408345) on Clearcasting, ahead of the Lightning Bolt filler, after Fire Nova's damage was corrected to its Forever spells (408423-408428; the engine had dealt the vanilla totem's, 1.8 times too much). About +1.0% in the raid run (seeds 1 and 50001, 10000 iterations) and less time out of mana; Fire Nova on cooldown instead loses about 5%. The line opens with auraIsKnown(Clearcasting) so a build without Elemental Focus, whose aura is never registered, does not fall through to Fire Nova on cooldown. Single outside source (kami-labs). Sim audit round 13: a wait line ahead of the Lightning Bolt lines holds the cast for Lava Burst when it is ready within 0.1 s. With 2.0 s bolts its cooldown returns exactly at a bolt's end, so any haste made the rotation start another bolt and lose about 5% of its Lava Bursts (a +0.01% haste probe read -0.35% at bare 60). Published numbers do not move; the haste weight does. Client 1.60.1.70755 (3 November evening hotfix push): Lava Burst is gone, its talent replaced by Call of Thunder (+5% critical strike chance on Lightning Bolt and Chain Lightning) and every Lava Burst trainer row removed, so the Lava Burst line and the wait line that held a bolt for it are dropped; Elemental Mastery is now Lightning Mastery (0.5 sec off Lightning Bolt only, no Chain Lightning cooldown, 15 seconds every 3 minutes), still fired from the cooldowns line.

expected_idle.reason: Magma Totem is the 2+ target branch of the fire totem choice (numberTargets >= 2); the ladder's default encounter is single-target, so Searing Totem (single-target branch above it) is always chosen instead.
Chain Lightning is gated on numberTargets >= 2 (AoE-only); the ladder's default encounter is single-target, so this line's own condition never passes.
Fire Nova is the 2+ target line (numberTargets >= 2); the ladder's default encounter is single-target.

priorityList.notes: Mana Spring Totem when your Water slot is empty: drop it before the pull, and again if it dies. At every rank it returns many times its own cost to your party over its 5 minutes. Two Mana Springs do not stack, so skip yours if a Restoration shaman already has one down for your group.

Lightning Mastery, trinkets and Blood Fury together: for its 15 seconds Lightning Bolt is half a second faster and Chain Lightning has no cooldown, so stack them inside it. A Troll presses Berserking after Mastery ends, since casting speed cannot push a bolt below the 1.5 second global cooldown.

Troll: Berserking the moment Lightning Mastery ends, never inside it. Inside Mastery your bolts already sit on the 1.5 second global cooldown and casting speed cannot shorten it; after it, Berserking makes your next 15 seconds of bolts faster.
Flame Shock whenever it is not on the target: from 25, with all three points of Call of Flame, it ticks for 21 seconds, and nothing else wants the shock cooldown.

Searing Totem on a single target, and in the pack until Magma Totem at 26: until then it is your only Fire totem that does damage, and from 12 it is the one Fire Nova bursts from. It is cheap for its damage and its bolts reach 20 yards, so drop it within 20 yards of the boss; from 26, Magma Totem costs several times its mana and only burns within 8 yards.
Magma Totem on two or more targets: it burns everything standing next to it for 20 seconds, or 40 from 34 with both points of Trial by Fire.

Chain Lightning on two or more targets: the first hit is bigger than a Lightning Bolt and each jump still deals 70% of the hit before it, for the same cast time as a Lightning Bolt, until Lightning Mastery makes the bolt faster.

Fire Nova on two or more targets: it bursts from your Fire totem, so drop that totem in the pack first (Searing Totem until 26, Magma Totem from then on). It only hits within 10 yards of that totem; on a single boss your Searing Totem stands 20 yards out, and Lightning Bolt is the better cast.

Lightning Bolt at the top rank while your mana is ahead of the fight: your mana percent above the share of the fight still to go. At 60, with Convection, rank 10 costs 198 mana to rank 9's 171 for about 20% more base damage; at any level you spend spare mana on your top rank and drop to a cheaper rank as soon as you fall behind. In a raid you never need to.

Lightning Bolt for everything else, at the rank your mana can carry to the end of the fight. In a raid at 60 that is rank 10, since raid buffs carry its mana so close to the end that the bigger bolt is worth it. Without raid buffs at 60 it is rank 8, and while leveling it is the rank for your level: 3 from 20 to 33, 4 until 38 (a Windshaper Skyborne keeps it at 39), 5 until 44, 6 until 50, 7 until 56 and 8 from 57.

panel_when.0: when your Water totem is down
panel_when.2: when Lightning Mastery has ended, Troll only
panel_when.3: when Flame Shock is not on the target
panel_when.4: on one target when Searing Totem is down
panel_when.5: on 2 or more targets when Magma Totem is down
panel_when.8: while mana % is over boss health %
